# Green Empire Builders

> Green Empire Builders is a general contractor and home builder serving Nassau & Suffolk Counties, Long Island, NY. Phone: (516) 595-0684. Office: 5020 Sunrise Hwy, Massapequa Park, NY 11762. Hours: Mon–Sat 8am–7pm. Request service: https://www.greenempirebuild.com/request-service.html


Green Empire Builders provides professional construction & renovation across Long Island, New York. The site lists 7 services and 21 service-area towns in Nassau and Suffolk Counties. All services are performed by licensed and insured professionals; free estimates are available by phone or through the request-service form.


## Services

- [Home Additions]https://www.greenempirebuild.com/services/home-additions/): Expand your living space with a professionally designed and built home addition — first-floor extensions, second-story additions, and room expansions built to match your existing structure.
- [Kitchen Remodeling]https://www.greenempirebuild.com/services/kitchen-remodeling/): Transform your kitchen into the heart of your home — custom cabinetry, premium countertops, updated layouts, and modern finishes designed around how you actually cook and live.
- [Bathroom Remodeling]https://www.greenempirebuild.com/services/bathroom-remodeling/): Upgrade your bathroom from dated to stunning — custom tile work, walk-in showers, new vanities, and complete layout redesigns handled by an experienced Long Island crew.
- [Dormer Construction]https://www.greenempirebuild.com/services/dormer-construction/): Add square footage, natural light, and headroom to your attic with a professionally built dormer — one of the most cost-effective ways to expand your Long Island home.
- [Basement Finishing]https://www.greenempirebuild.com/services/basement-finishing/): Turn your unfinished basement into livable square footage — home offices, playrooms, entertainment spaces, or guest suites built with proper waterproofing, egress, and code compliance.
- [Full Home Renovation]https://www.greenempirebuild.com/services/full-home-renovation/): Complete home transformations — gut renovations, multi-room remodels, and whole-house updates managed by a single trusted contractor from first demo to final walkthrough.
- [Custom Home Building]https://www.greenempirebuild.com/services/custom-home-building/): Build the home you've always wanted, exactly the way you want it — custom design, premium materials, and hands-on project management from foundation to final key.
- [All Services](https://www.greenempirebuild.com/services/): Full list of services offered.
